fact: Council of Ministers Decision No. 358 of 2026, dated 15 July 2026, creates the National Authority for Cybersecurity and Digital Sovereignty under the Council of Ministers, tasked with preparing the national cybersecurity strategy, monitoring national threats and responding to cyber incidents.
title: قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 358 لسنة 2026 م بشأن إنشاء الهيئة الوطنية للأمن السيبراني والسيادة الرقمية
publisher: مجلس الوزراء (Council of Ministers, Government of National Unity)
